resources.string: Press any button on the pad for Gamepad %1$d
The keyboard key each on-screen control sends. It must match the key set in the game.
In a race the left stick steers, the right trigger accelerates and the left trigger brakes.
In a race the D-pad steers, accelerates and brakes like keys, and the triggers accelerate and brake. The stick does not steer.
This gamepad is set to Digital: in a race the D-pad steers, accelerates and brakes, whatever is set for it here.
Where the game\'s Force Feedback effects are felt: on the phone or on the gamepad, never both at once. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
The phone plays collisions, landings and gear changes, the engine at high revs and hard cornering.
Gamepad 1 plays the game\'s effects as they are. Their strength is set in the game: Options → Controllers → Force Feedback.
